title: Honeycomb Words
scene: Build words from six outer letter tiles and one mandatory center tile.
artConstraint: The playable board is exactly seven large hexagonal tiles: one central A, surrounded by six single-letter tiles C, R, T, E, S, P. Every tile contains exactly one letter. Show a player building a word that uses the center A. Keep all seven tiles visible and distinct; any learning hints are pictograms beside the board.
